meta.name: Fay Gurme — cinematic editorial
meta.description: A new visual direction built around the existing logo's green and the venue's actual photography. This is a redesign, not a palette match to the original webpage.

color.palette_type: analogous warm neutrals and deep green

primary.role: Logo green, calls to action, active categories

accent.role: Bronze overlines and small graphic details

neutral.usage: Ivory page, slightly darker menu surface, dark green foreground; no pure black

color.contrast_strategy: All reading text passes 4.5:1 on both light surfaces; dark overlays protect text over video

typography.font_style_notes: Elegant, high-contrast serif with restrained italics; locally hosted variable fonts include Turkish glyphs

layout.grid_system: Monumental layered typographic opening, native sticky scroll scene, three-chapter tasting story, moving type ribbon, editorial featured rail, practical menu grid
layout.alignment_tendency: Editorial asymmetry followed by strict menu alignment

elevation.shadow_style: Subtle and limited to floating elements
elevation.depth_cues: Surface contrast, hero seal overlap and dialog backdrop

motion.entrance_pattern: Staggered FAY letters, clipped film reveal, photo layers and masked text; 1.25s
motion.philosophy: Expressive storytelling with native scrolling. Compact mobile scenes, full reduced-motion fallback; direct /menu skips presentation.

components.button_style: Rectangular green primary, outlined secondary, circular icon controls; minimum 44px targets
components.input_style: Wide ivory search, persistent accessible name, visible focus, native clear action
components.card_style: Real food photo, serif name, exact source price, short description; full details on tap
components.navigation_pattern: Sticky top header, desktop category sidebar, mobile category dialog and bottom dock
components.modal_style: Native dialog with focus management; bottom sheet on phones
components.list_style: Editorial featured rail and paginated adaptive menu grid
components.component_notes: Source dietary symbols and allergen metadata are preserved; no inferred safety claims

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: An elegant restaurant's printed menu brought to life

visual_language.ornamentation: One typographic seal, fine lines and discreet overlines
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous in the introduction; practical in the menu
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Large left headline balanced by right portrait film
visual_language.contrast_level: Strong type contrast with restrained surface variation
visual_language.texture_usage: Real food and interior textures, no artificial grain

composition.flow_direction: Vertical with optional horizontal featured discovery
composition.grouping_strategy: Original food categories grouped by dining stage
composition.negative_space_role: Create calm and give photos room

imagery.photo_treatment: Twelve documented AI-assisted restorations, all other food and interior photos from original source; preserve dish identity
imagery.graphic_elements: Monumental FAY letters, rotated photo stack, orbital menu link, hairline borders

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Magnetic menu CTA, inspection marker on featured photos, image scale
interaction_feel.transition_personality: Cinematic entrance and scroll choreography; quick menu response
interaction_feel.loading_style: Reserved photo space and actual video poster; no blocking intro
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Moderate on the landing, restrained in the menu

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Explain the state and offer a useful next action

overview.fallback_strategy: Static layout and manual chapters without GSAP; reduced motion removes animation and auto playback
overview.primary_technology: GSAP 3.13.0 / ScrollTrigger, CSS native sticky, SVG and HTML video

background_effects.description: Actual venue footage within a portrait hero panel

params.blend_mode: Normal with a dark text-protection overlay

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: Opening, tasting chapters, ribbon and section entrances
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: Transform, opacity, clip reveal and background color
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: Opening and ribbon scrub; chapters select at .34 and .7 progress

scroll_morphing.description: Ivory opening dissolves into dark green; photo layers separate, end copy appears

text_effects.description: FAY letters enter individually; headline lines reveal upward; ribbon tracks scroll

params.split_strategy: Three decorative letters; semantic h1 line wrappers

cursor_effects.description: System pointer remains; 82px marker only inside featured photos on fine pointer devices

image_effects.description: Entrance clip reveal, rotated story photos, menu photo hover scale

params.reveal_animation: 600ms opacity and translate for the hero only

svg_animations.description: Menu ring rotates with opening scene progress

visual_effects.composite_notes: Local GSAP and ScrollTrigger; no external runtime requests. Locally restored 1080p film is used at the original 30 fps, paused outside view. 12 AI-assisted photo restorations are documented separately; original files and PNG masters retained. Manual story tabs work without GSAP, compact layout on phones. Local frame-wise Real-ESRGAN restoration completed; 75% restored / 25% source blend, original source archived.
